''See also: [[Ayana Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Ayana is a mentor within the [[Gardeners]], responsible for training three individuals destined to hold that role. She possesses a striking and ghostly appearance characterized by pale blond hair, light pink eyes, and skin that lacks color. Most notably, she has six-inch black [[Iron|iron]] claws growing from her fingertips instead of fingernails, which she often scrapes together. Her voice is described as a harsh, grating rasp that can sound like a specter's howl or the [[wind]] through rocks. Born to parents who were members of the [[Imperial Guard]], Ayana was abandoned and raised by the [[Gray Island]]. She possesses the inherited gifts of her lineage, including [[Kameira blood]], and she has learned to utilize these abilities despite her complicated history with the Guard. In combat or training, she is known for being a demanding instructor who utilizes her [[Iron|iron]] claws and can also wield [[shears]] or daggers by encasing them within her finger-blades. While she is a formidable figure, she has experienced defeat at the hands of her [[Vessel]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Ayana possesses a ghostly complexion with colorless skin and hair, complemented by pale pink eyes. She wears a black half-[[The mask|mask]] over her mouth and is described as appearing like a black-clad ghost. Her hands feature six-inch, razor-sharp [[Iron|iron]] claws extending from her fingernails.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An exceptional member of the [[Council]], Ayana serves as a mentor for those training to be [[Gardeners]]. She is a cautious individual who believes that trusting too easily invites betrayal and teaches that enemies can potentially become allies. Her past includes being viewed as a demanding stepmother and a monster.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Ayana serves as a mentor and consultant to [[Shera]], providing her with lessons and advice. She also taught [[Lucan]] that waiting is a skill. Additionally, [[Meia]] had to face Ayana as a girl during instances of rule-breaking.}}
